timing.summary: c1 is introduced: the before source has no magicless decoding format, while the after source requires an explicit format setting that the fixed harness never makes.

claims.necessity_reason: The review established this target coverage obligation; this turn compares only its timing.

before.requirement: Decode magicless frames through a configured DStream.
before.reason: The before interface is described as compression only, its stream parser requires an ordinary magic number, and its DStream parameter setter supports only maximum window size. Magicless decoding was not a supported format on this side.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The old stream calls this header parser, which rejects prefixes lacking an ordinary frame magic number.
The old stream invokes the ordinary header parser and propagates its error.

after.requirement: Set ZSTD_f_zstd1_magicless on the DStream before decoding a magicless frame.
after.reason: The new format requires an instruction, and the new setter can apply it before decoding. The fixed harness initializes or resets the stream, then calls decompressStream without setting the format; the ordinary format causes magicless input to fail the header check.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: DStream creation reaches this initializer, which selects the ordinary format by default.
The stream passes its selected format to the header parser and propagates parser errors.
With the ordinary format, this parser requires frame magic and rejects a magicless prefix.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The helper consumes the seed prefix before the target submits remaining bytes to the stream.

claims.comparison_reason: The missing format-setting call blocks c1 after the change. Before the change, the magicless decoding requirement did not exist, so there is no same before-side blocker.
